seo.title: Mesh Actor Ops | Kain Actor Server Site
seo.description: Actor-backed local site runtime with route contracts, command docs, search, FAQ, and control-room surfaces.

hero.title: Ship a local actor mesh with a website attached.
hero.body: This mode treats the website as the presentation shell for a Node-hosted actor runtime. Routes, actors, docs, commands, search, and intake are all in one manifest family.

feature_cards.title: Node-hosted runtime
feature_cards.body: Local HTTP serving is built into the helper with no external dependency surface.

feature_cards.title: Actor topology as data
feature_cards.body: Routes, actors, forms, and search documents are emitted as manifest-driven artifacts.

feature_cards.title: Kain stays in the loop
feature_cards.body: The website runtime is still driven through Kain entrypoints and stdlib wrappers.

docs_links.title: Local supervision model

docs_links.label: Read supervision

faq_items.question: Is this a real long-lived server lane?
answer: Today the long-lived process is Node-hosted, but Kain owns the authored topology and reporting surface.

faq_items.question: Can I extend this with queues or sockets?
answer: Yes. The actor lane is intentionally data-driven so more transports can land without rewriting the whole site pack.
